*** Add File: oauth_callback.py
+import json
+import os
+from typing import Any, Dict, Optional
+
+import requests
+
+
+GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT = "https://oauth2.googleapis.com/token"
+
+
+def exchange_authorization_code(
+    code: str,
+    redirect_uri: str,
+    client_id: Optional[str] = None,
+    client_secret: Optional[str] = None,
+) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    client_id = client_id or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID")
+    client_secret = client_secret or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET")
+    if not client_id or not client_secret:
+        raise ValueError("GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID and GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET are required")
+
+    response = requests.post(
+        GOOGLE_TOKEN_ENDPOINT,
+        data={
+            "code": code,
+            "client_id": client_id,
+            "client_secret": client_secret,
+            "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
+            "grant_type": "authorization_code",
+        },
+        timeout=30,
+    )
+    response.raise_for_status()
+    return response.json()
+
+
+def oauth_callback_handler(event: Dict[str, Any], context: Any = None) -> Dict[str, Any]:
+    params = event.get("queryStringParameters") or {}
+    code = params.get("code")
+    redirect_uri = params.get("redirect_uri") or os.environ.get("GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI")
+
+    if not code:
+        return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "missing_code"})}
+    if not redirect_uri:
+        return {"statusCode": 400, "body": json.dumps({"error": "missing_redirect_uri"})}
+
+    try:
+        tokens = exchange_authorization_code(code=code, redirect_uri=redirect_uri)
+        return {"statusCode": 200, "body": json.dumps(tokens)}
+    except requests.HTTPError as exc:
+        body = exc.response.text if exc.response is not None else str(exc)
+        return {"statusCode": 502, "body": json.dumps({"error": "token_exchange_failed", "details": body})}
+    except Exception as exc:
+        return {"statusCode": 500, "body": json.dumps({"error": "internal_error", "details": str(exc)})}
*** End Patch

*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: start_oauth_login.py
+import base64
+import hashlib
+import os
+import secrets
+import sys
+import urllib.parse
+import webbrowser
+
+
+AUTHORITY = os.getenv("GOOGLE_OAUTH_AUTHORITY", "https://accounts.google.com")
+AUTHORIZE_PATH = "/o/oauth2/v2/auth"
+CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID")
+REDIRECT_URI = os.getenv("GOOGLE_OAUTH_REDIRECT_URI", "http://localhost:8080/callback")
+SCOPE = os.getenv("GOOGLE_OAUTH_SCOPE", "openid email profile")
+
+
+def _code_verifier() -> str:
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(secrets.token_bytes(32)).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def _code_challenge(verifier: str) -> str:
+    digest = hashlib.sha256(verifier.encode("ascii")).digest()
+    return base64.urlsafe_b64encode(digest).rstrip(b"=").decode("ascii")
+
+
+def build_authorization_url() -> str:
+    if not CLIENT_ID:
+        raise RuntimeError("GOOGLE_OAUTH_CLIENT_ID is required")
+    verifier = _code_verifier()
+    challenge = _code_challenge(verifier)
+    params = {
+        "client_id": CLIENT_ID,
+        "redirect_uri": REDIRECT_URI,
+        "response_type": "code",
+        "scope": SCOPE,
+        "state": secrets.token_urlsafe(16),
+        "code_challenge": challenge,
+        "code_challenge_method": "S256",
+        "access_type": "offline",
+        "prompt": "consent",
+    }
+    url = f"{AUTHORITY}{AUTHORIZE_PATH}?{urllib.parse.urlencode(params)}"
+    return url
+
+
+def main() -> int:
+    try:
+        url = build_authorization_url()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        print(str(exc), file=sys.stderr)
+        return 1
+    print(url)
+    webbrowser.open(url, new=1, autoraise=True)
+    return 0
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    raise SystemExit(main())
*** End Patch
